title: Garlicky Chicken Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic Indian-inspired dish made with marinated chicken, cooked in a rich tagine sauce with a hint of Tunisian spices.

ingredients.name: Tunisian Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: available at Middle Eastern grocery stores

instructions: Heat ghee or oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add ginger and garlic and cook for another minute.
Add marinated chicken and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add tagine sauce mix, crushed marzipan, coconut milk, and Tunisian spice blend. Stir well.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot garnished with fresh cilantro, if desired.
